title: Retry a 503 like a network error
request: getJson retries network errors but gives up at once when the server answers 503 Service Unavailable. Retry a 503 the same way; other error statuses must still fail at once.

plan.title: Find where the response status is checked
Make a 503 count as a failure the retry sees
Test a 503 then a 200, and a 404 that is not retried

plantedBug.about: Every failed status is retried, so a 404 is retried too.

acceptance: npm test passes, with a test where a 503 then a 200 returns the JSON body after two calls, and a 404 is called once.

title: Show minutes in formatDuration
request: formatDuration prints long timings as seconds only (125000 ms is "125.0 s"). From one minute on, print minutes and seconds instead, such as "2 min 5 s".

plan.title: Read how formatDuration picks its unit
Test 125000 ms and exactly one minute

plantedBug.about: Exactly one minute still prints "60.0 s".

acceptance: npm test passes, with 125000 ms printed as "2 min 5 s" and 60000 ms as "1 min 0 s".

title: Make withRetry call fn exactly attempts times
request: withRetry calls fn one time fewer than attempts says: with attempts 3 it calls fn only twice, and with attempts 1 it never calls it. Make it call fn exactly attempts times.

plan.title: Find the loop that counts attempts
Test that attempts 3 means three calls

plantedBug.about: After the last attempt fails, withRetry returns the error instead of throwing it.

acceptance: npm test passes, with attempts 3 calling fn three times and rejecting with the last error.
